filter.purpose: Button that switches All music to the Hidden filter: the files the app isn't showing, each with its reason.
filter.where: All music screen, beside the search box.

label.purpose: Accessible name of the hidden files table.
label.where: All music, Hidden filter, the table (screen readers only).

count_one.purpose: How many hidden files are listed, when it is one. Same pattern as the track counts.
count_one.where: All music, Hidden filter, above the table.

count_other.purpose: How many hidden files are listed (all of them, or those the search leaves).
count_other.where: All music, Hidden filter, above the table.

empty.where: All music, Hidden filter, when no file is hidden and nothing is searched.

noMatch.purpose: Says the search finds no hidden file.
noMatch.where: All music, Hidden filter, when a search leaves no hidden file.

columns.reason.purpose: Column heading for why a file is hidden.
columns.reason.where: All music, Hidden filter, table header.

reason.userHid.purpose: Reason for a file the user hid. Nothing in the app hides a file yet.
reason.userHid.where: All music, Hidden filter, Reason column.

reason.clearedInbox.purpose: Reason for a file that was cleared from the Inbox. The Inbox arrives in Phase 2; no file has this reason yet.
reason.clearedInbox.where: All music, Hidden filter, Reason column.

reason.extraFile.purpose: Reason for an extra copy of a track when no best file is known to name: another file of the track was chosen as its best (ROADMAP 1.7).
reason.extraFile.where: All music, Hidden filter, Reason column.

reason.extraFileNamed.purpose: Reason for an extra copy of a track: names the track and the file that was chosen as its best (ROADMAP 1.7).
reason.extraFileNamed.where: All music, Hidden filter, Reason column.

showAgain.purpose: Button that shows a file the user hid in the lists again. Undo hides it again. Wording from ROADMAP 1.11.
showAgain.where: All music, Hidden filter, last column, on a file the user hid.

showMore.purpose: Button that lists the next hidden files. Same wording as Review's (review:more).
showMore.where: All music, Hidden filter, under the table, when more files wait.

matches_one.purpose: Says one hidden file matches the search and its track is not in the results (ROADMAP 1.11, owner decision 2026-10-12). Followed by a dot and the Show them link.
matches_one.where: All music, under the search box, when a search matches a hidden file.

matches_other.purpose: Says how many hidden files match the search and their tracks are not in the results (ROADMAP 1.11, owner decision 2026-10-12). Followed by a dot and the Show them link.
matches_other.where: All music, under the search box, when a search matches hidden files.

showThem.purpose: Link that opens the Hidden filter with the same search. Wording from ROADMAP 1.11.
showThem.where: All music, under the search box, after the count of hidden files that match.
